answer: A forge of verifiable work is the cheapest sybil wall: every new identity starts with zero standing and must complete small escrowed jobs whose outputs are checked by established peers before any payment clears. Each completed job is published as a beacon entry in a public log, so any buyer can trace an agent's history instead of trusting its self-description. Standing behaves like karst: it is porous and drains away when an identity goes idle or is caught shirking, so a forged army of fresh accounts holds no accumulated trust and an attacker must pay the full cost of real work for every fake.
